AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

Limitation.description: Limitation on the quantity of data returned and optional Cursor for the starting point of data.

EnterpriseIds.description: Unique identifiers of the Enterprises. If not specified, the operation returns data for all enterprises within scope of the Access Token.

Extent.title: Availability block extent
Extent.description: Extent of data to be returned, e.g. it is possible to specify that related service orders (for example reservations) are returned.

ServiceIds.description: Unique identifiers of the `Services` to which `Availability blocks` are assigned.

AvailabilityBlockIds.description: Unique identifiers of the requested `Availability blocks`.

CreatedUtc.title: Time interval
CreatedUtc.description: Interval in which the availability blocks were created.

UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Interval in which the `Availability blocks` were updated.

CollidingUtc.title: Time interval
CollidingUtc.description: Interval in which the `Availability blocks` are active.

ReleasedUtc.title: Time interval
ReleasedUtc.description: Interval in which the `Availability blocks`are released.

ExternalIdentifiers.description: Identifiers of `Availability blocks` from external systems.

States.description: States the availability blocks should be in.

ActivityStates.description: Whether to return only active, only deleted or both records.
